parameters.name: AclOperationType
parameters.description:
The type of the operation allowed by the access control list (ACL). Valid values:

*   **Write**: data writes.
*   **Read**: data reads.
*   **Describe**: reads of transaction IDs.
*   **IdempotentWrite**: idempotent data writes to clusters.
*   **IDEMPOTENT_WRITE**: idempotent data writes to clusters. This value is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.
*   **DESCRIBE_CONFIGS**: configuration query. This value is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.

parameters.name: AclOperationTypes
parameters.description:
The types of operations allowed by the ACL. Separate multiple operations with commas (,).

Valid values:

*   **Write**: data writes.
*   **Read**: data reads.
*   **Describe**: reads of transaction IDs.
*   **IdempotentWrite**: idempotent data writes to clusters.
*   **IDEMPOTENT_WRITE**: idempotent data writes to clusters. This value is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.
*   **DESCRIBE_CONFIGS**: configuration query. This value is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.

>  This parameter is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.

parameters.name: AclPermissionType
parameters.description:
The authorization method. Valid values:

*   Deny
*   ALLOW

>  This parameter is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.

parameters.name: AclResourceName
parameters.description:
The name of the resource.

*   The value can be the name of a topic or consumer group.
*   You can use an asterisk (\*) to indicate the names of all topics or consumer groups.

parameters.name: AclResourcePatternType
parameters.description:
The mode that is used to match resources. Valid values:

*   **LITERAL:** full match
*   **PREFIXED**: prefix match

parameters.name: AclResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

*   **Topic**: topic
*   **Group**: consumer group
*   **Cluster**: cluster
*   **TransactionalId**: transactional ID

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description:
The IP address of the source.

> 

*   You can specify only a specific IP address or use the asterisk (\*) wildcard character to specify all IP addresses. CIDR blocks are not supported.

*   This parameter is available only for serverless ApsaraMQ for Kafka instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka delete-acl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-v0h1cng00000 --username test120000 --acl-resource-type Topic --acl-resource-name demo --acl-resource-pattern-type LITERAL --acl-operation-type Write --acl-operation-types Write,Read --acl-permission-type DENY --host 0 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
